blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable multimodal capabilities but suffer from prohibitive computational overhead due to the massive number of visual tokens. While token pruning is a promising solution, existing methods still suffer from two major drawbacks: 1) unreliable pruning criteria that fail to accurately localize task-specific regions due to inherent attention biases or query-agnostic designs, and 2) suboptimal pruning strategies that employ rigid, non-adaptive schedules, overlooking the dynamic evolution of token redundancy across different model depths. To address these challenges, we propose LearnPrunerV2, which extends the previous two-stage heuristic framework (LearnPruner) into a fully learnable architecture. Specifically, we integrate lightweight learnable modules into every layer of the VLM backbone, which estimate token importance by fusing intrinsic visual saliency with extrinsic query relevance captured via a shadow token. By uncovering a consistent staircase redundancy pattern across VLM layers, we further introduce Budget-Deterministic Pruning (BDP) to establish a hardware-friendly schedule with fixed per-layer budgets. Extensive experimental results across various benchmarks and VLMs demonstrate that LearnPrunerV2 consistently outperform previous state-of-the-art methods. Notably, LearnPrunerV2 preserves 99.8% of the original performance when pruning 77.8% of visual tokens on LLaVA-v1.5, achieving a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)显示出了显著的多模式能力,但由于视觉符号数量之多,其计算间接费用令人望而却步。 虽然象征性的打压是一个很有希望的解决办法,但现有方法仍然有两个主要缺点: 1)由于内在的注意力偏差或查询-不可知性设计,无法准确定位特定任务区域的不可靠的推倒标准;2)采用刚性,非适应性时间表的次优化推倒策略,俯瞰不同模型深度的符号冗余的动态演变. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议LearnPrunerV2,将前两个阶段的heuristic框架(LearnPruner)扩展为一个完全可以学习的架构. 具体地说,我们把轻量级的可学习模块整合到VLM主干线的每层中,它通过将内在的视觉亮度与通过阴影信号捕获的外在查询相关性相接来估计出象征性的重要性. 通过在VLM层中发现一致的阶梯冗余模式,我们进一步引入了"预算决定"(President-Deterministic Pruning (BDP)),以建立一个硬件友好的,每个层固定预算的时间表. 跨越各种基准和VLM的广泛实验结果表明,LearnPrunerV2的成绩始终高于以往最先进的方法。 值得注意的是,在LLaVA-v1.5上刷取了77.8%的可视标志时,LearnPrunerV2保留了99.8%的原始性能,实现了更高的精度效率取舍.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Following the rapid evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) ( Achiam et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024a ; Yang et al., 2025a ) , Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have extended these sophisticated reasoning capabilities to the multimodal domain, leading to significant advancements in visual understanding and grounding. Generally, VLMs employ a pretrained visual encoder to transform visual inputs into a sequence of tokens, which are subsequently concatenated with textual instruction tokens as input for the LLM. Visual tokens often dominate the input sequence, typically numbering in the hundreds and potentially expanding to thousands for high-resolution images or long videos. Since the computational complexity of self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length, such a massive influx of visual tokens drastically inflates inference latency, rendering VLMs impractical for real-time or resource-constrained deployment.
blocks.zh: 在大语言模型(LLMs)(Achiam等人,2023年;Liu等人,2024年a;Yang等人,2025年a)迅速演变后,Visual-Langage Models(VLMs)将这些精密的推理能力扩展到多式联运领域,导致视觉理解和地面的重大进步. 一般来说,VLMs使用预先训练的视觉编码器将视觉输入转换成一个符号序列,这些符号随后与文字指令符号配合,作为LLM的输入. 视觉符号通常在输入序列中占据主导地位,通常以数百个编号,对于高分辨率的图像或长视频,可能扩展至数千个. 由于自觉尺度的计算复杂程度与序列长度成四倍,这种大量视觉信号的流入大大地夸大了推断的延迟性,使VLM对实时部署或资源限制的部署不切实际。

blocks.en: To alleviate these computational bottleneck, numerous studies have explored token pruning as a viable strategy for reducing the visual sequence length. Given the inherent redundancy in visual modality, prior research has demonstrated that a substantial proportion of visual tokens can be discarded with minimal impact on model performance. Fundamentally, the effectiveness of token pruning hinges on two core dimensions: how to prune (the selection criterion) and where to prune (the pruning schedule). In this paper, we argue that existing approaches remain suboptimal in both aspects.
blocks.zh: 为了缓解这些计算瓶颈,许多研究都探索了象征性的挤压作为减少视觉序列长度的可行策略. 鉴于视觉模式的内在冗余,先前的研究表明,很大一部分视觉符号可以丢弃,对模型性能的影响最小. 从根本上说,象征性的修饰的有效性取决于两个核心层面:如何修饰(选择标准)和在哪里修饰(修饰时间表)。 在这份文件中,我们争辩说,在这两个方面,现有的办法仍然不够理想。

blocks.en:
Unreliability of Pruning Criteria. Existing pruning criteria primarily fall into two categories: importance-based and diversity-based. The former utilizes attention scores from either the visual encoder or the LLM to identify significant tokens. However, as noted in LearnPruner ( Takezoe et al., ) , visual encoders often suffer from attention sink that fail to localize foreground objects, while LLM attention exhibits a strong positional bias, with reliable query-aware signals only beginning to emerge from the intermediate layers onward. This creates a dilemma: early pruning is computationally efficient but "blind", while late-stage pruning is semantically guided but yields marginal speedup.
The latter category utilizes token-wise feature similarity to select the maximum coverage subset, aiming to preserve global visual diversity. These methods are inherently query-agnostic, making it challenging to adapt pruning results to different user instructions. While recent efforts ( Cai et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) attempt to incorporate auxiliary text encoders to facilitate cross-modal guidance, as shown in Figure 1 , these encoders are limited to word-level granularity, failing to resolve the global semantic context of the image. This suggests that the internal attention of LLMs remains essential for capturing task-specific visual information.
blocks.zh:
运行标准的不可靠性。 现行标准主要分为两类:基于重要性的标准和基于多样性的标准。 前者利用视觉编码器或LLM的注意力分数来识别重要的符号. 然而,正如LearnPruner(Takezoe et al.,)中所指出的,视觉编码器经常受到注意力沉积,无法将前景物体定位,而LLM注意力则表现出强烈的位置偏差,可靠的查询-知觉信号才开始从中间层向上出现. 这造成了一种两难局面:早期的普鲁因在计算效率上是"盲的",而后期的普鲁因则被精密地引导,但产生边际加速.
后一类利用符号特性的相似性来选择最大覆盖子集,旨在维护全球视觉多样性. 这些方法本质上是查询-不可知的,因此很难根据不同的用户指令调整普鲁因结果. 虽然最近的努力(Cai等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年b)试图纳入辅助文本编码器以便利跨模式指导,如图1所示,但这些编码器仅限于词级颗粒性,未能解决图像的全球语义背景. 这表明,对特定任务的视觉信息进行捕捉而言,有限责任管理小组的内部关注仍然至关重要。

blocks.en: Suboptimality of Pruning Strategies. Beyond selection criteria, existing methods typically employ static, one-pass pruning schedules or layer specific heuristics, overlooking the intrinsic coupling between token redundancy and VLM layer depth. Indeed, recent studies have revealed the layer-wise dynamics: AutoPrune ( Wang et al., ) demonstrates that VLM attention exhibits significant fluctuations across layers, particularly in reasoning-intensive scenarios. Furthermore, TwigVLM ( Shao et al., 2025 ) reveals that in the deep layers of VLMs, even the complete removal of visual tokens does not necessarily degrade performance. Collectively, these findings suggest that as visual information is incrementally integrated into linguistic representations, the significance of visual tokens is not uniform across layers but evolves throughout the hierarchy, motivating a progressive, layer-adaptive pruning strategy.
blocks.zh: 奔跑策略的缺点. 除选择标准外,现有方法通常采用静态的,单行穿透的计时表或层层特定推力,俯瞰符号冗余和VLM层深度之间的内在耦合. 事实上,最近的研究揭示了层层动态: AutoPrune (Wang et al., ) 表明,VLM的注意力在各层之间表现出显著的波动,特别是在推理密集的情景中. 此外,TwigVLM(Shao等人,2025年)也表明,在VLM的深层中,即使完全去除视觉符号也不一定会降低性能. 这些调查结果表明,随着视觉信息逐渐融入语言表达方式,视觉符号的意义并不是各层一致的,而是在整个层级中演化,激发出一种渐进的,多层次的适应性修饰策略.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, LearnPruner ( Takezoe et al., ) takes an initial step by adopting a two-stage token pruning framework that first removes redundant vision tokens via a learnable pruning module after the vision encoder, then retains only query-relevant tokens in the LLM’s middle layers based on text-to-vision attention scores. While effective, its singular input signals and hand-crafted schedule cannot fully capture the continuous evolution of token redundancy.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些限制,LearnPruner(Takezoe等人,)迈出了第一步,采用了一个两阶段的代号pruning框架,首先在视觉编码器之后通过可学习的普鲁恩模块去除多余的视觉符号,然后在LLM的中层只保留基于文本到视觉关注分数的与查询相关的符号. 其单数输入信号和手工制作的时间表虽然有效,但不能完全捕捉到符号冗余的持续演变.

blocks.en: Building upon this, we propose LearnPrunerV2 , a purely learnable pruning framework for VLMs. Unlike the hybrid design of its predecessor, our framework adopts a unified architecture by integrating a lightweight pruning module into every layer of the VLM backbone. Moreover, a learnable "shadow token" is appended to the input sequence during the prefill stage to aggregate the preceding context and capture cross-modal correlations. Each pruning module subsequently combines intrinsic visual saliency from local features with extrinsic query relevance derived from the shadow token to predict importance scores for individual visual token. Through end-to-end joint optimization, LearnPrunerV2 aligns pruning decisions with the layer-specific evolution of visual significance, which in turn allows pruning modules to determine the optimal exit depth for each token. This dynamic mechanism enables the model to flexibly adjust its pruning trajectory based on the complexity of both images and queries. Furthermore, to address practical budget-constrained scenarios, we introduce Budget-Deterministic-Pruning (BDP) strategy. BDP utilizes offline-calibrated statistics to maintain a strictly fixed token count across every layer and adopts diversity-aware selection to mitigate the impact of a non-adaptive schedule. This ensures deterministic inference latency and maximized batching throughput, providing a robust solution for high-concurrency real-world deployment.
blocks.zh: 以此为基础,我们提出LearnPrunerV2,一个纯粹可以学习的VLM的修炼框架. 与其前身的混合设计不同,我们的框架采用了一个统一的架构,将一个轻量级的普鲁因模块整合到VLM主干线的每一层. 此外,在预填阶段的输入序列上还附加了可学习的"影子令牌",以汇总上下文并捕捉跨模式的关联性. 每个推算模块随后结合了来自本地特征的内在视觉显著性,以及来自阴影符的外部查询相关性,以预测单个视觉符的重要分数. 通过端对端联合优化,LearnPrunerV2将普鲁恩决定与视觉意义的层特异性演化相协调,这反过来又允许普鲁恩模块确定每个符号的最佳退出深度. 这种动态机制使模型能够根据图像和查询的复杂程度灵活调整其运行轨迹. 此外,为了解决预算拮据的实际情况,我们采用了预算确定-支出战略。 发展局利用离线调整的统计数据,在每一层都保持严格固定的符号数,并采用了解多样性的选择,以减轻非适应时间表的影响。 这确保了确定推断的延迟性,并最大限度地增加批量吞吐量,为高货币现实世界的部署提供了强有力的解决办法。

blocks.en: Benefiting from its model-agnostic design, LearnPrunerV2 can be seamlessly integrated into diverse VLM architectures, such as LLaVA ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Lin et al., 2023 ) and Qwen-VL ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) . Extensive experiments on multiple VQA benchmarks shows that our method outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods under different retention ratios. For example, when pruning 94.4% visual tokens in LLaVA-NeXT-7B, LearnPrunerV2 preserve 96.2% of the original model performance, while achieving a 9.7 × \times reduction in TFLOPs. In summary, the contributions of our work are threefold: • We present LearnPrunerV2, a purely learnable token pruning framework that adopts a progressive pruning strategy. Compared to LearnPruner, it offers a more unified and flexible solution. • We introduce the Budget-Deterministic-Pruning schedule to assign fixed per-layer token budgets, enabling hardware-friendly inference. • We conduct extensive experiments on various VLMs and vision-language benchmarks, demonstrating that LearnPrunerV2 consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance across different retention ratios.
blocks.zh: LearnPrunerV2从其模型不可知设计中受益,可以无缝地融入多种VLM架构,如LLAVA(Liu等人,2023年;Liu等人,2024年b;Lin等人,2023年b)和Quen-VL(Wang等人,2024年;Bai等人,2025年). 对多种VQA基准的广泛实验表明,我们的方法在不同的留存比率下,比以前最先进的方法要好。 例如,当在LLaVA-NEXT-7B中运行94.4%的视觉符号时,LearnPrunerV2保留了原模型性能的96.2%,同时在TFLOP中实现了9.7×\时间的减少. 总而言之,我们工作的贡献有三个方面: 我们向大家介绍LearnPrunerV2,这是一个纯粹可以学习的标志性打压框架,它采用了渐进式打压策略。 与LearnPruner相比,它提供了一个更加统一和灵活的解决方案. 我们采用预算-决定-预测时间表,分配每个层次的固定代号预算,从而能够进行硬件友好推论。 我们广泛进行了关于各种VLM和视觉语言基准的实验,表明LearnPrunerV2在不同的保留比率方面始终取得了最先进的业绩。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. Vision Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.1. 远景语言模式

blocks.en: Building upon the foundational reasoning power of Large Language Models (LLMs) ( Touvron et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Achiam et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024a ; Cai et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025a ) , Vision-Language Models (VLMs) ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) demonstrate remarkable capabilities showing strong performance on diverse multimodal tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering, and visual grounding. A standard VLM typically comprises three components: a visual encoder to transform visual inputs into tokens, a vision-language connector to align the modality, and a LLM to serve as the cognitive engine for multimodal integration and complex reasoning. However, this paradigm incurs significant computational costs as the massive number of visual tokens. For instance, LLaVA-v1.5 ( Liu et al., 2023 ) converts a 336x336 image into 576 tokens, advanced VLMs like LLaVA-NeXT ( Liu et al., 2024b ) (tiling-based) and Qwen2.5-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) (native dynamic resolution) support high-resolution inputs that further expand visual token sequences. Furthermore, in video understanding scenarios, the visual token count scales linearly with the number of sampled frames ( Lin et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024b ) . Such extensive sequences pose a severe bottleneck for real-time applications, driving the urgent need for efficient inference of VLMs.
blocks.zh: 借助大语言模型(LLMs)的基础推理力(Touvron等人,2023年;Jiang等人,2023年;Achiam等人,2023年;Liu等人,2024年a年;Cai等人,2024年;Yang等人,2025年a年),Visual-Language Models(VLMs)(Liu等人,2023年;Li等人,2024年;Bai等人,2025年;Zhu等人,2025年)显示出在图像字幕、视觉问题回答和视觉地面等多种多模式任务上的出色表现。 一个标准VLM一般由三个部分组成:一个将视觉输入转换成符号的视觉编码器,一个视觉语言连接器来调整模式,以及一个LLM作为多模式融合和复杂推理的认知引擎. 然而,这种范式作为大量视觉标志物而产生大量的计算成本. 例如,LLaVA-v1.5(Liu等人,2023年)将一个336x336的图像转换为576个令牌,高级VLM如LLaVA-NEXT(Liu等人,2024年b)和Qwen2.5-VL(Bai等人,2025年)支持高分辨率输入,进一步扩大视觉令牌序列. 此外,在视频理解情景中,视觉符号按抽样帧数线性计算(Lin等人,2023年;Chen等人,2024年b) 。 这种广泛的序列对实时应用构成严重的瓶颈,因此迫切需要有效推断VLM.

blocks.en: 2.2. Vision Token Reduction for VLMs
blocks.zh: 2.2. 减少自愿地雷影响愿景

blocks.en: Given the inherent redundancy in visual signals, token reduction has emerged as a promising direction to enhance VLM efficiency. Various works ( Chu et al., 2024 ; Cha et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) attempt to compress vision token into more compact representations. While effective in reducing computation, these methods typically change the model architecture and require retraining from scratch, resulting in high training costs and potential degradation of the performance upper bound. In this work, we mainly focus on token pruning techniques that can be directly applied to existing VLMs.
blocks.zh: 鉴于视觉信号的内在冗余,象征性的减少已成为提高VLM效率的有希望的方向。 各种作品(Chu等人,2024年;Cha等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年;Huang等人,2024年;Wu等人,2026年)试图将视觉符号压缩为更为紧凑的表示. 这些方法虽然在减少计算方面很有效,但通常会改变模型结构,需要从零开始再培训,导致培训成本高,性能上限可能退化。 在这部作品中,我们主要侧重于可以直接应用于现有VLM的符号推算技术.

blocks.en: From the perspective of pruning criteria, existing methods can be broadly categorized into two types: importance-based and diversity-based. Importance-based methods ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Zhang et al., 2025c ; Shao et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) utilize attention scores to select top-k important tokens and discard the rest. To remove query-irrelevant visual tokens, FastV ( Chen et al., 2024a ) leverages the attention of the last text token at the second LLM layer as the principled signal, while SparseVLM ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) first identifies text tokens strongly correlated with visual input, and then employs their attention scores to achieve more precise guidance for pruning. Alternatively, to eliminate inherent visual redundancy, VisionZip ( Yang et al., 2025b ) and VisPruner ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) leverage [CLS] attention from the visual encoder to identify key salient tokens and perform pruning before the LLM. One limitation of importance-based methods is their reliance on attention maps, which makes them incompatible with Flash Attention ( Dao et al., 2022 ) . Diversity-based methods aims to select a diverse set based on similarity between tokens ( Alvar et al., 2025 ; Wen et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Jeddi et al., 2025 ) . DivPrune ( Alvar et al., 2025 ) formulates token pruning as a Max-Min Diversity Problem, whereas DART ( Wen et al., 2025 ) explicitly minimizes duplication by comparing candidate tokens against a set of pivots. Furthermore, CDPruner ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) calculates inter-token similarity conditioned on their relevance to the current instruction and use the determinantal point process to maximize the conditional diversity.
blocks.zh: 从完善标准的角度来看,现有方法可以大致分为两类:基于重要性和多样性。 基于重要性的方法(Chen等人,2024a); Zhang等人,2025c;Shao等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025a;Yang等人,2025b;Zhang等人,2026年)利用注意力分数来选择顶级重要信物,丢弃其他信物. 为了删除与查询无关的视觉符号,FastV(Chen等人,2024a)利用第二LLM层最后一个文本符号的注意力作为原则信号,而SparseVLM(Zhang等人,2025c)首先识别与视觉输入密切相关的文本符号,然后利用他们的注意力分数来获得更精确的探测指导. 或者,为了消除内在的视觉冗余,VisionZip(Yang等人,2025b)和VisPruner(Zhang等人,2025a)利用视觉编码器的[CLS]注意,在LLM之前识别关键显著的符号并进行螺旋. 基于重要性的方法的一个局限性是它们依赖于关注地图,这使得它们与闪光关注(Dao等人,2022年)不兼容. 基于多样性的方法旨在根据符号之间的相似性选择一套多样化的方法(Alvar等人,2025年;Wen等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年b;Jeddi等人,2025年)。 隐藏 (Alvar 等人,2025年)将象征性的寻访定为Max-Min多样性问题,而DART(Wen等人,2025年)则通过将候选的寻访符号与一组小孔进行对比,明确将重复减少到最低程度。 此外,CDPruner(Zhang等人,2025年b)根据它们与当前指令的相关性来计算各语种之间的相似性,并利用决定性点过程来尽量扩大有条件的多样性。

blocks.en: From the perspective of pruning schedules, most studies conduct static pruning at a specific layer, overlooking the layer-wise evolution of token redundancy. Alternatively, some works adopt multi-stage pruning schedules ( Xing et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., ; Takezoe et al., ) . For instance, PDrop ( Xing et al., 2024 ) applies progressive pruning with uniform ratios and intervals; AutoPrune ( Wang et al., ) derives sample-specific policies by quantifying cross-modal mutual information; LearnPruner ( Takezoe et al., ) employs a two-stage scheme, applying stage-specific pruning criteria to different phases. Despite these advancements, such heuristic designs remain misaligned with the dynamic nature of visual information processing, leading to suboptimal pruning schedules.
blocks.zh: 多数研究从推算时间表的角度出发,在特定的层进行静态推算,俯瞰代号冗余的逐层演化. 或者,有些工作采用多阶段的推算时间表(Xing等人,2024年;Ye等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年;Takezoe等人,2025年)。 例如,PDrop(Xing等人,2024年)采用比例和间隔一致的渐进式推算;AutoPrune(Wang等人,)通过量化跨模式的相互信息得出特定样本政策;LearnPruner(Takezoe等人,)采用两阶段办法,对不同阶段适用特定阶段的推算标准。 尽管取得了这些进步,但这种热度设计仍然与视觉信息处理的动态性质不符,导致不尽人意的挤压时间表.

blocks.en: Existing VLMs generally consist of three primary components: a vision encoder, projector and LLM. Since our methods operate within the LLM, we first provide a formal definition of its architecture. The LLM is composed of a stack of Transformer-based ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) decoder layers, each containing a causal self-attention to capture contextual dependencies and a feed-forward network for feature refinement.

blocks.en: 3.2. Learnable Pruning Criterion
blocks.zh: 3.2. 可学习的普鲁宁标准

blocks.en: Unlike prior works that rely on pre-defined heuristic rules, our approach employs learnable modules to evaluate token importance in a data-driven manner. The core challenge lies in constructing effective inputs for the module. A straightforward baseline is to use raw token features, similar to the Mixture-of-Depth (MoD) approach ( Raposo et al., 2024 ) . However, while these features contain rich semantic information, they are inherently query-agnostic, capturing only intrinsic visual saliency rather than task-specific importance. Although text-to-vision attention provides such relevance, it faces two critical limitations. First, the requirement for explicit attention scores is incompatible with efficient attention implementations such as FlashAttention. Second, as observed in FastV ( Chen et al., 2024a ) , attention scores in VLMs are heavily dominated by the textual modality, visual tokens often receive scores orders of magnitude lower (e.g., around 10 − 4 10^{-4} in LLaVA-1.5). Such faint signals lack sufficient numerical contrast, making it difficult for learnable modules to capture fine-grained importance differences.
blocks.zh: 与以前依赖预先定义的热力学规则的作品不同,我们的方法使用可学习的模块来以数据驱动的方式评价象征性的重要性. 核心挑战在于为该模块提供有效的投入。 一个直接的基线是使用原始符号特征,类似于深度混合方法(Raposo等人,2024年)。 然而,虽然这些特征包含丰富的语义信息,但它们具有内在的查询-不可知性,只捕捉内在的视觉特征,而不是特定任务的重要性. 虽然文本对视觉的关注提供了这种相关性,但它面临两个关键的局限性。 首先,明确关注分数的要求与FlashAtthind等高效关注执行不相容. 第二,如FastV(Chen et al., 2024a)所观察到的,VLM的注意力分数被文字模式严重控制,视觉符记往往得到的分数级较低(例如LLaVA-1.5中大约10−4 10^{-4}). 这种微弱的信号缺乏足够的数值对比,使得可学习的模块难以捕捉到细微的重要性差异.

blocks.en: 3.3. Budget-Deterministic Pruning
blocks.zh: 3.3. 预算的确定性

blocks.en: Once the pruning modules are trained, one can directly apply threshold-based pruning at each layer during inference, yielding sample-adaptive pruning schedules. However, practical deployment typically requires a fixed compute budget, which prior methods approximate by reporting the average number of retained tokens per layer. Furthermore, even with a fixed global budget, different inputs may produce distinct per-layer pruning trajectories, resulting in inconsistent memory access patterns and computation graphs, which is inherently hardware-unfriendly for optimized deployment.
blocks.zh: 一旦修饰模块经过了训练,人们可以在推论中在每个层直接应用基于阈值的修饰,产生采样适应的修饰时间表. 然而,实际部署通常需要固定的计算预算,即报告每层平均保留物证数目的先前方法。 此外,即使有固定的全球预算,不同的投入也可能产生不同的每层穿插轨迹,导致内存访问模式和计算图不一致,这在本质上不利于优化部署的硬件。

blocks.en: To address these issues, we seek a deterministic per-layer schedule that fixes the token count at every layer. A natural question arises: how should such a schedule be determined? To this end, we investigate the underlying pruning characteristics learned by our modules. We randomly sample 500 image-text pairs from the LLaVA-mix665k dataset ( Liu et al., 2023 ) and execute threshold-based pruning with τ = 0.5 \tau=0.5 (identical to training). Figure 3 visualizes the mean and variance of the per-layer token retention ratio across all samples on LLaVA-v1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL. Surprisingly, the learned pruning trajectories exhibit high consistency across diverse inputs, with low inter-sample variance, and display a pronounced staircase pattern. This phenomenon suggests that through the joint optimization of all pruning modules, the model has autonomously identified a robust structural redundancy pattern in its architecture, reflecting the intrinsic stages of information flow and assimilation.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,我们寻求确定每个层次的时间表,确定每个层次的象征数字。 一个自然的问题:如何确定这样一个时间表? 为此,我们调查了我们模块所学到的深层的螺旋特征。 我们从LLaVA-mix665k数据集(Liu等人,2023年)随机抽取500个图像文本对,并用 \\ tau=0.5(与训练相同)执行基于阈值的夹击。 图3可视化LLaVA-v1.5和Quen2.5-VL上所有样本的每层符号保留率的平均值和差异。 令人惊讶的是,所学的穿梭轨迹在各种投入中表现出高度的一致性,样本间差异较小,并显示出明显的楼梯模式. 这种现象表明,通过联合优化所有普鲁姆模块,该模型在其架构中自主地确定了一个强大的结构冗余模式,反映了信息流动和同化的内在阶段.

blocks.en: Taking LLaVA-v1.5 (Figure 3 (a)) as an example, the trajectory begins with a sharp drop at the first layer, immediately discarding uninformative visual content such as background regions. In the subsequent early layers, the retention ratio enters a stable plateau, where virtually no further pruning occurs, suggesting that the incremental information gained across these shallow layers provides little discriminative signal. As the model progresses into the middle layers, a second significant decline emerges. This aligns with prior findings ( Takezoe et al., ; Wu et al., 2026 ) where the middle layers serve as the primary stage for intensive cross-modal interaction. At this stage, visual features are progressively aligned with linguistic queries, causing a substantial portion of visual tokens to become redundant. Moving into the deep layers, the retention ratio gradually approaches zero, confirming that essential visual information has been integrated into the hidden states of the text tokens, rendering the original visual modality entirely redundant for final response generation.
blocks.zh: 以LLaVA-v1.5(图3(a))为例,轨迹从第一层的锐减开始,立即丢弃背景区域等非信息视觉内容. 在后来的早期层中,留存率进入一个稳定的高原,那里几乎不再出现进一步挤压现象,这表明从这些浅层中获得的增量信息几乎没有产生任何歧视性信号. 随着模型向中层发展,出现了第二次显著下降. 这与以前的调查结果(Takezoe等人, ;Wu等人, 2026年)一致,其中中层是密集跨模式互动的主要阶段。 在现阶段,视觉特征逐渐与语言查询保持一致,导致相当一部分视觉符号变得多余. 进入深层,保留率逐渐接近零,证实基本视觉信息已经整合到文本符的隐藏状态中,使得原始视觉模式对于最终响应生成是完全多余的.

blocks.en: Motivated by the stability of the learned pruning trajectories, we propose Budget-Deterministic Pruning strategy, which repurposes the offline-calibrated average retention ratios 𝜼 = [ η 1 , η 2 , … , η L ] \boldsymbol{\eta}=[\eta_{1},\eta_{2},\dots,\eta_{L}] as a structural prior, constructing a deterministic per-layer budget that preserves the learned layer-wise pruning distribution. Specifically, given a user-specified budget n ¯ \bar{n} , defined as the average number of retained visual tokens per layer, the total token budget across all layers is n ¯ ⋅ L \bar{n}\cdot L . Since the calibrated trajectory would naturally consume N v ​ i ​ s ⋅ ∑ l = 1 L η l N_{vis}\cdot\sum_{l=1}^{L}\eta_{l} tokens in total, we compute a global scaling factor to reconcile the two: (11) α = n ¯ ⋅ L N v ​ i ​ s ⋅ ∑ l = 1 L η l . \alpha=\frac{\bar{n}\cdot L}{N_{vis}\cdot\sum_{l=1}^{L}\eta_{l}}. The per-layer token budget is then determined as: (12) n l = ⌊ η l ⋅ N v ​ i ​ s ⋅ α ⌉ , l = 1 , 2 , … , L , n_{l}=\lfloor\eta_{l}\cdot N_{vis}\cdot\alpha\rceil,\quad l=1,2,\dots,L, where ⌊ ⋅ ⌉ \lfloor\cdot\rceil denotes rounding to the nearest integer. This formulation applies a uniform scaling to the calibrated pruning profile, ensuring that the relative layer-wise distribution is preserved under any target budget.

blocks.en: While deterministic budgets ensure computational predictability, they inevitably sacrifice instance-level adaptivity—a key advantage of threshold-based pruning. To mitigate this, we introduce a diversity-aware selection mechanism that dynamically optimizes the token composition within each layer’s fixed capacity. At each layer l l , we first identify a candidate set of informative tokens whose importance scores exceed the threshold τ \tau , with the candidate count denoted as n l ′ = ∑ i = 1 N v ​ i ​ s 𝕀 ⁡ ( s i ( l ) > τ ) n^{\prime}_{l}=\sum_{i=1}^{N_{vis}}\mathbb{I}(s_{i}^{(l)}>\tau) . If n l ′ ≤ n l n^{\prime}_{l}\leq n_{l} , the budget is sufficient to accommodate the entire candidate set, and we simply retain the top- n l n_{l} tokens by importance score. Conversely, when n l ′ > n l n^{\prime}_{l}>n_{l} , the model considers more tokens important than the allocated budget permits. In this case, naively selecting the top- n l n_{l} tokens by scores may lead to the loss of critical visual information. Instead, we ensure more comprehensive visual representations by adapting the principle of diversity-aware selection from DART ( Wen et al., 2025 ) . Under this approach, the top- n p n_{p} tokens ranked by importance score are first selected as pivot tokens. For each remaining candidate, we compute its cosine similarity to all pivots and identify its maximum similarity value. The remaining n l − n p n_{l}-n_{p} slots are filled by candidates with the lowest maximum similarity. Ultimately, this mechanism strikes a balance between importance and diversity, which is particularly effective in low-budget scenarios.

blocks.en: Datasets and Benchmarks. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on 9 widely-used image-based multimodal benchmarks, including GQA ( Hudson and Manning, 2019 ) , ScienceQA-IMG ( Lu et al., 2022 ) , TextVQA ( Singh et al., 2019 ) , POPE ( Li et al., 2023 ) , MME ( Fu et al., 2023 ) , VQAv2 ( Goyal et al., 2017 ) , MMBench ( Liu et al., 2024c ) , MMBench-CN ( Liu et al., 2024c ) and MMVet ( Yu et al., 2023 ) . Moreover, we experiment with 3 video understanding benchmarks, including TGIF-QA ( Jang et al., 2017 ) , MSVD-QA ( Xu et al., 2017 ) , and MSRVTT-QA ( Xu et al., 2017 ) . All experiments on these benchmarks follow the default settings and evaluation metrics.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. In the experiments, we keep the base VLM weights frozen and use the LLaVA-mix665k dataset ( Liu et al., 2023 ) to train our pruning modules. We apply our LearnPrunerV2 to various VLM architectures, including LLaVA-v1.5 ( Liu et al., 2023 ) for image understanding, LLaVA-NeXT ( Liu et al., 2024b ) for high-resolution inputs, Video-LLaVA ( Lin et al., 2023 ) for video scenarios (see Appendix for results) and Qwen2.5-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) for broader generalization. For comprehensive comparison, we select several recent token pruning methods as baselines, including importance-based methods (e.g., FastV ( Chen et al., 2024a ) , SparseVLM ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) and VisPruner ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) ), diversity-based approaches (e.g., DART ( Wen et al., 2025 ) and CDPruner ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) ), and LearnPruner ( Takezoe et al., ) which introduces learnable parameters for pruning and employs a heuristic pruning schedule.

blocks.en: Results on LLaVA-v1.5. As shown in Table 1 , we first evaluate our method on LLaVA-v1.5-7B, where images are represented by a fixed sequence of 576 tokens. The results demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms all previous methods across all three retention ratios. Notably, when retaining 128 tokens, our method maintains a remarkable 99.8% of the vanilla model’s performance, surpassing the previous state-of-the-art method by 1.3%, and this performance gap further widens to 2.1 % 2.1\% when the budget is restricted to only 32 tokens. Since both our model and LearnPruner employ learnable modules, this significant lead directly validates the superiority of our proposed pruning criterion and pruning schedule.

Results on LLaVA-NeXT. To verify its scalability for high-resolution scenarios, we evaluate our method on LLaVA-NeXT-7B. LLaVA-NeXT handles high-resolution inputs by partitioning the image into multiple sub-grids and encoding them independently, yielding a massive baseline of 2,880 visual tokens. As shown in Table 2 , LearnPrunerV2 retains 99.7% of the original performance while utilizing only 22.2 % 22.2\% of the visual tokens. Furthermore, on several benchmarks such as POPE, MME, and MMBench, our pruned model achieves performance that is either comparable to or even superior to its vanilla counterpart. These results indicate that high-resolution inputs inherently contain substantial visual redundancy, where many tokens may contribute marginal or even distracting signals.
By removing uninformative visual context, the model can more accurately focus on the most salient features, thereby leading to more precise predictions.
blocks.zh:
关于LLaVA-NEXT的结果。 为了验证其对高分辨率情景的可扩展性,我们对LLaVA-NEXT-7B的方法进行评估。 LLaVA-NEXT处理高分辨率输入,将图像分割成多个子网格并独立编码,产生2,880个视觉符号的巨大基线. 如表2所示,LearnPrunerV2保留了99.7%的原始性能,而只使用22.2%的视觉标志。 此外,在诸如POPE、MME和MMBench等若干基准上,我们完善的模型的性能或可与其香草对应物相比,或甚至优于后者。 这些结果表明,高分辨率输入本身就含有大量的视觉冗余,许多符号可能起到边际甚至分散信号的作用.
通过去除非信息视觉上下文,模型可以更准确地聚焦于最显著的特征,从而导致更精确的预测.

blocks.en: Results on Qwen2.5-VL. To further assess the broad applicability of LearnPrunerV2, we extend our evaluation to Qwen2.5-VL-7B, a leading open-source VLM with an architecture distinct from the LLaVA family. Since the original SFT data for Qwen2.5-VL is not publicly accessible, we leverage the LLaVA-mix665k dataset to generate model responses, which serve as pseudo-labels for training our pruning modules. Furthermore, although Qwen2.5-VL naturally supports native dynamic resolution, we fix the input size to a standardized budget of 1,280 tokens to ensure a fair and consistent comparison across all pruning methods. As shown in Table 3 , LearnPrunerV2 still maintain its dominant performance, even exceeding 100% average relative accuracy at 66.7 % 66.7\% and 77.8 % 77.8\% pruning rates, showing the robust generalizability of our approach.
blocks.zh: 关于Quen2.5-VL的结果. 为了进一步评估LearnPrunerV2的广泛适用性,我们的评价扩大到Quen2.5-VL-7B,这是一个主要的开源VLM,其架构不同于LLaVA家族. 由于Qwen2.5-VL的原始SFT数据无法公开获取,因此我们利用LLaVA-mix665k数据集生成模型响应,作为培训我们运行模块的伪标签. 此外,虽然Quen2.5-VL自然支持本地动态解析,但我们将输入大小固定为1 280个令牌的标准化预算,以确保公平、一致地比较所有喷发方法。 如表3所示,LearnPrunerV2仍然保持其主导性表现,甚至超过了平均相对准确度的100%,分别为66.7%、66.7 %和77.8 %,这表明我们的方法具有强有力的普遍性。

blocks.en: 4.3. Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3. 读取研究

blocks.en: We evaluate the learnable pruning criterion and budget-deterministic pruning strategy on LLaVA-v1.5-7B. Unless otherwise specified, all experiments use a fixed budget of 64 tokens, and we report average relative performance over GQA, SQA, VQA T , POPE, and MME.
blocks.zh: 我们评价LLaVA-v1.5-7B的可学习的计算标准和预算决定性计算战略。 除非另有说明,所有实验都使用64个符号的固定预算,我们报告GQA、SQA、VQA T、POPE和MME的平均相对性能。

blocks.en: Input components. As shown in Table 4 (a), we compare three configurations for the pruning module’s input. When relying solely on the hidden states, the module determines token importance based only on intrinsic visual redundancy, which results in a performance of 96.6 % 96.6\% . By concatenating the relevance feature, the model can further incorporate cross-modal correlations with the textual query, boosting the average performance to 97.2 % 97.2\% . However, inter-layer attention fluctuations often introduce distracting noise. The gating mechanism mitigates this by filtering transient signals, stabilizing importance estimation and yielding a performance of 97.8 % 97.8\% .
blocks.zh: 输入组件。 如表4(a)所示,我们比较了三种配置,用于计算模块的投入。 当仅仅依赖隐藏状态时,模块只根据内在的视觉冗余来决定象征重要性,结果性能达到96.6%的96.6\%. 通过整合相关性特征,该模型可以进一步融入与文本查询的交叉模式关联,将平均性能提升到97.2%的97.2\%. 然而,层间注意力波动往往会引致分心的噪音. 测量机制通过过滤瞬态信号、稳定重要性估计和得出97.8%的97.8%的性能来缓解这种情况。

blocks.en: Relevance source. Table 4 (b) investigates the influence of different cross-modal relevance sources. While the last instruction token is a conventional choice for sequence aggregation, utilizing its attention scores results in poor performance ( 96.5 % 96.5\% ) because the attention scores are numerically overwhelmed by the hidden states. Although last token logits ( 97.4 % 97.4\% ) alleviate the scaling bottleneck, they still underperform the shadow token ( 97.8 % 97.8\% ), which we attribute to the inherent multi-task interference between next-token prediction and pruning guidance. In contrast, the shadow token serves as a dedicated aggregator that focuses exclusively on capturing instruction-relevant token importance.
blocks.zh: 相关性来源。 表4(b)调查了不同跨模式相关来源的影响。 虽然最后一个指示符号是常规的序列汇总选择,但利用它的注意力分数导致性能差(96.5%96.5\%),因为注意力分数在数字上被隐藏状态所压倒. 尽管上一个符号对数(97.4 % 97.4 % ) 缓解了缩放瓶颈,但是它们仍然表现不佳的阴影符号(97.8 % 97.8 % ),我们将此归结为下个键的预测和推导之间的内在多任务干扰. 反之,阴影符号是专门汇总器,专门集中收集与指示相关的符号重要性。

blocks.en: Parameter sharing scheme. The learnable pruning module mainly consists of a relevance projector ( MLP ϕ \text{MLP}_{\phi} ) and a scoring network ( MLP ψ \text{MLP}_{\psi} ). Table 4 (c) evaluates different parameter sharing schemes for these components. Our hybrid strategy achieves the best performance ( 97.8 % 97.8\% ), outperforming both fully independent ( 97.3 % 97.3\% ) and fully shared ( 96.9 % 96.9\% ) counterparts. This is because attention logits exhibit significant inter-layer variance, necessitating a layer-specific MLP ϕ \text{MLP}_{\phi} for adaptive mapping. Conversely, a shared MLP ψ \text{MLP}_{\psi} receives more gradients from different layers, facilitating robust convergence and stabilizing the optimization to learn a generalized pruning criterion.
blocks.zh: 参数共享计划. 可学习的 pruning模块主要包括一个相关投影器(MLP\text{MLP})和一个评分网络(MLP\text{MLP}_{\psi}). 表4(c)评价这些组件的不同参数共享方案. 我们的混合战略取得了最佳业绩(97.8 %),表现优于完全独立(97.3 % 97.3 %)和完全共享(96.9 %)的对应方。 这是因为注意记录显示显著的层间差异,需要用一层特定的 MLP {\ text{MLP}来进行适应性映射。 相反,共享的 MLP \\ text{ MLP}_{\psi} 从不同层次得到更多的梯度,促进强烈的趋同和稳定优化,以学习一个通用的穿插标准。

blocks.en: Visual token selection. Table 5 evaluates the impact of our diversity-aware selection against the standard Top-K strategy under a fixed layer-wise budget. While both approaches perform similarly at a higher budget of 64 tokens ( 97.8 % 97.8\% vs. 97.7 % 97.7\% ), our strategy demonstrates a clear advantage when the budget is restricted to 32 tokens, outperforming Top-K by 0.9 % 0.9\% . This gap suggests that simple Top-K selection is prone to information redundancy, as tokens with the highest scores are often spatially clustered or semantically similar. In contrast, our approach encourages the selection of more diverse visual cues, thereby broadening the overall information coverage within the restricted budget.
blocks.zh: 视觉符号选择 。 表5对照固定层预算下的标准Top-K战略,评价我们选择多样性的影响。 尽管这两种方法在64个令牌的较高预算(97.8% 97.8\%对97.7% 97.7\%)中同样发挥作用,但当预算仅限于32个令牌时,我们的战略显示出明显的优势,比Top-K高0.9%. 这一空白表明简单的Top-K选择容易出现信息冗余,因为得分最高的符记往往在空间上被集群或类似. 相反,我们的做法鼓励选择更加多样化的视觉提示,从而在有限的预算范围内扩大总体信息覆盖面。

blocks.en: 4.4. Efficiency Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4. 效率分析

blocks.en: To demonstrate the efficiency of LearnPrunerV2, we measure the FLOPs, prefill time, total inference time and KV cache size of the pruned model compared to the vanilla LLaVA-NeXT-7B. All experiments are conducted on the POPE benchmark. As shown in Table 6 , when the number of visual tokens is reduced from 2,880 to 160, we achieve a 9.7 × \times reduction in TFLOPs and a 6.2 × \times speedup in prefill time. Furthermore, the KV cache size is slashed by 8.7 × \times , while the total inference time improves by 3.7 × \times . These results highlight the effectiveness of our framework in reducing the computational overhead of VLMs
blocks.zh: 为了展示LearnPrunerV2的效率,我们测量了与香草LLAVA-NEXT-7B相比,被pruned模型的FLOP,预填时间,总推论时间和KV缓存大小. 所有实验都是根据POPE基准进行的. 如表6所示,当视觉信使的数量从2,880个减少到160个时,我们实现了TFLOP的9.7×\时间的减少,预填时间的6.2×\时间的加速. 此外, KV 缓存大小被8. 7 ×\times 斜拉, 而总推论时间则改善 3. 7 ×\times 。 这些结果突出表明了我们框架在减少自愿活动清单计算间接费用方面的效力。

blocks.en: 5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结论

blocks.en: We introduce LearnPrunerV2, a learnable progressive token pruning framework for accelerating VLMs. It estimates token importance from intrinsic visual saliency and query relevance, and employs a Budget-Deterministic Pruning (BDP) schedule that assigns fixed per-layer budgets by exploiting the inherent architectural redundancy of VLMs. Extensive experiments on multiple VLM architectures and benchmarks demonstrate strong accuracy-efficiency trade-offs and clear gains over prior methods.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了LearnPrunerV2, 一个可以学习的渐进式符号推敲框架,以加速VLM. 它从内在的视觉重要性和查询相关性中估算出象征性的重要性,并使用一个预算-决定性运行(BDP)时间表,通过利用VLM的内在建筑冗余来分配每层固定的预算. 对多种VLM架构和基准的广泛试验表明,在精确效率方面进行了强有力的权衡,比以前的方法有了明显的收益。

blocks.en: A.1. Results on Video-LLaVA
blocks.zh: A.1. 关于视频LLAVA的结果

blocks.en: To further assess the broad applicability of LearnPrunerV2, we extend our evaluation from the image domain to video understanding. Video-LLaVA ( Lin et al., 2023 ) processes each video by uniformly sampling 8 frames and encoding them independently, producing a total of 2,048 visual tokens. We evaluate on three established video quesion answering benchmarks: TGIF-QA ( Jang et al., 2017 ) , MSVD-QA ( Xu et al., 2017 ) and MSRVTT-QA ( Xu et al., 2017 ) . Following ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , we use the first 1,000 samples from each benchmark for evaluation, and employ GPT-4.1 to assist in scoring open-ended responses. As shown in Table 7 , LearnPrunerV2 consistently outperforms FastV across all three benchmarks, especially under lower retention ratios. These results demonstrate the strong generalizability of LearnPrunerV2 from image-based to video-based VLMs.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评估LearnPrunerV2的广泛适用性,我们的评价从图像域延伸到视频理解. 视频LLAVA (Lin等人,2023年)通过统一采样8帧并独立编码处理每个视频,共产生2,048个视觉符号. 我们评价三个既定的视频quesion答题基准:TGIF-QA(Jang等人,2017年),MSVD-QA(徐等人,2017年)和MSRVTT-QA(徐等人,2017年). 随后(Zhang等人,2025a),我们利用每个基准的首批1000个样本进行评估,并使用GPT-4.1协助评分无限响应. 如表7所示,在所有三个基准中,特别是在较低的保留率下,LearnPrunerV2的业绩始终高于FastV。 这些结果显示了LearnPrunerV2从基于图像到基于视频的VLM的强烈通用性.

blocks.en: A.2. Data Efficiency
blocks.zh: A.2. 数据效率

blocks.en:
To investigate the data efficiency of LearnPrunerV2, we train the model with varying proportions of the LLaVA-mix665k ( Liu et al., 2023 ) training dataset (from 10% to 100%)
and evaluate the resulting performance on both LLaVA-v1.5-7B and LLaVA-NeXT-7B
under two retention budgets, respectively. As shown in Figure 4 , LearnPrunerV2 exhibits remarkable data efficiency across both models. On LLaVA-v1.5, using only 10% of the training data already achieves 98.5% relative performance under the 128-token budget. As the training data scales to 50%, performance largely converges, achieving results on par with full-dataset training. Moreover, we observe that lower token budgets generally require more training data to reach convergence. This can be attributed to the fact that more aggressive pruning demands a more precise pruning criterion, which in turn requires sufficient training signal to learn.
blocks.zh:
为了调查LearnPrunerV2的数据效率,我们用不同比例的LLaVA-mix665k来培训该模型 (Liu等人,2023年)培训数据集(从10%到100%)
并评价LLaVA-v1.5-7B和LLaVA-NEXT-7B的绩效
分别在两个留存预算之下。 如图4所示,LearnPrunerV2在两种模型中显示出显著的数据效率。 在LLaVA-v1.5方面,仅使用10%的培训数据,在128托肯预算下已经实现了98.5%。 随着培训数据达到50%,业绩基本趋同,取得了与全面数据集培训同等的成果。 此外,我们还注意到,较低的象征性预算一般需要更多的培训数据才能趋于一致。 这可以归结于一个事实,即更具侵略性的打压需要更精确的打压标准,这反过来又需要足够的训练信号来学习.

blocks.en: A.3. Visualization
blocks.zh: A.3. 可视化

blocks.en: To better illustrate the pruning behavior learned by LearnPrunerV2, we visualize the token pruning results across different layers on LLaVA-v1.5-7B. As shown in Figure 5 and Figure 6 , LearnPrunerV2 first removes a large number of uninformative tokens at shallow layers, such as those corresponding to padding regions or background areas. Moving to the middle layers, the retained tokens progressively converge toward query-relevant visual regions. By the deeper layers, nearly all visual tokens have been pruned. This progressive pruning pattern reveals the inherent characteristics of visual information flow within VLMs, which is consistent with findings in prior works ( Wu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了更好地说明LearnPrunerV2所学到的奔跑行为,我们可视化LLaVA-v1.5-7B上不同层的象征性奔跑结果. 如图5和图6所示,LearnPrunerV2首先在浅层移除了大量非信息化符号,如与铺设区域或背景区域对应的符号. 向中间层移动,所保留的标志逐渐向与查询有关的视觉区域汇合。 到了更深层,几乎所有的视觉标志都已经被刷掉了. 这种进步的穿透模式揭示了VLM内部视觉信息流的内在特征,这与之前的作品中的结论是一致的(Wu等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Additionally, we compare the importance score heatmaps predicted by LearnPrunerV2 with the last-token attention scores adopted by previous methods. As shown in Figure 7 and Figure 8 , last-token attention suffers from notable positional bias and exhibits substantial fluctuations across layers, and typically requires deeper layers (e.g., layer 16) to localize query-relevant regions. In contrast, benefiting from our learnable shadow token and gating mechanism, LearnPrunerV2 is able to identify query-relevant regions at much earlier layers (e.g., layer 12), while also exhibiting stronger cross-layer consistency.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们比较了LearnPrunerV2预测的重要分数热映射和以往方法采用的最后注意分数。 如图7和图8所示,最后注意的问题有明显的位置偏差,各层之间波动很大,通常需要更深层(如第16层)才能将与查询有关的区域本地化。 相比之下,LearnPrunerV2从我们可学习的影子标志和标点机制中获益,能够在更早的层次(如第12层)中识别出与查询相关的区域,同时也表现出更强的跨层次一致性.
